scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.build:worker: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-worker ./cmd/kin-worker
scripts.build:egress: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-egress ./cmd/kin-egress
scripts.format: biome format --write && gofmt -w worker && pnpm -C web format
scripts.format:check: biome format && node scripts/check-gofmt.mjs && pnpm -C web format:check
